'''Carbon-Freeze Exhaust units''', also known as '''Carbon-Freeze Exhausts''' and '''CF Exhausts''', were located throughout the [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|Carbon-freezing chamber]] levels of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. An exhaust unit would spray out a quick blast of gas, temprorarily [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|freezing]] anyone that would happen to be in the Carbon-Freeze Exhaust unit's way.<ref name="SuperEMP" />
